mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friend_request (sender_id, receiver_id, message, status) VALUES (#{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{message}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE friend_request SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM friend_request WHERE sender_id = #{senderId} AND receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND status = 0
